info.title: metano-typescript
info.description: TypeScript target for the Metano transpiler — CLI tool that converts annotated C# types to TypeScript

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to the C# project file (.csproj) [Required]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for generated TypeScript files [Required]

options.name: --package-root
options.description: Root directory of the consumer package (default: parent of --output) [Default: null]

options.name: --dist
options.description: Path (relative to packageRoot) where the JS build output lives (default: ./dist) [Default: @"./dist"]

options.name: --src-root
options.description: TypeScript source root relative to packageRoot (default: inferred from first segment of output path). Used to compute the dist prefix when output targets a subdirectory (e.g., src/domain/). [Default: null]

options.name: --namespace-barrels
options.description: Emit an additional src/index.ts root barrel mirroring the C# namespace hierarchy via `export namespace` blocks (opt-in; see ADR-0006).

options.name: --strip-interface-prefix
options.description: Drop the C# `I` prefix from generated interface names when it is followed by another uppercase letter (opt-in). Collisions with sibling types in the same namespace keep the prefix and emit MS0017.

options.name: --file-prefix
options.description: Opaque text written verbatim at the top of every generated file, followed by a single newline. Use to inject formatter / lint directives (e.g., a Biome `biome-ignore-all` block, a Prettier `// @prettier-ignore`, a `// @generated` provenance marker). [Default: null]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Run the full pipeline but do NOT write any files. Print a preflight summary (file count + total line count + per-file paths) instead. Useful for CI preflight checks and exploratory runs. Skips the package.json update too.

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: Disable the incremental cache. Forces a full transpilation even when sources, references, and outputs are byte-identical to the previous run.

options.name: --watch
options.description: Stay running and re-transpile every time a .cs / .csproj / .props / .targets file under the project directory changes. Combine with the incremental cache (default) for instant re-runs when nothing actually changed.

options.name: --asset
options.description: Static asset to copy into the output directory alongside generated files. Repeat the flag for multiple assets. Each value is either an absolute path or an `absolutePath=relativeDestination` pair where the destination is interpreted relative to --output (no rooted paths, no `..` segments). When the destination is omitted, the asset's path relative to the project directory is mirrored under the output tree. Wired from `<MetanoAsset Include="..." OutputPath="..." />` by the MSBuild target. [Default: null]
